import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {title_of_event}
{title_of_event}
{event_details}
Date: {scheduled_date}
{extra_info}
""" def create_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, event_details: str, scheduled_date: str, extra_info: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML event invitation. Parameters: title_of_event (str): The name or title of the event. event_details (str): A comprehensive description of the event. scheduled_date (str): The scheduled date for the event. extra_info (str): Extra information or instructions. Returns: str: A string containing sanitized HTML suitable for safe display. """ # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS attacks. escaped_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) escaped_details = html.escape(event_details, quote=True) escaped_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) escaped_extra = html.escape(extra_info, quote=True) # Render the template with sanitized values. invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( title_of_event=escaped_title, event_details=escaped_details, scheduled_date=escaped_date, extra_info=escaped_extra ) return invitation_html
